env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

# The three spellings fixed for ?. selections must survive ejection as
# valid Go: ... for variadic last parameters, parentheses for a
# receive-only channel element, and a quoted tag holding a backtick.
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
grep 'Maybe\[func\(\.\.\.int\) int\]' out/main.go
grep 'chan (\(<-chan int)\)' out/main.go
grep 'tag:`v' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..
cd out
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectoptspelled

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"
)

type Maybe[T any] *T?

var failed bool

func check(name string, cond bool, got, want any) {
	if !cond {
		failed = true
		fmt.Println("FAIL", name+":", "got", got, "want", want)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", name)
}

type HolderV struct {
	F Maybe[func(...int) int]
}

func selectVariadic(h HolderV?) Maybe[func(...int) int] { return h?.F }

type HolderC struct {
	C Maybe[chan (<-chan int)]
}

func selectChan(h HolderC?) Maybe[chan (<-chan int)] { return h?.C }

type HolderT struct {
	S Maybe[struct {
		X int "tag:`v"
	}]
}

func selectTagged(h HolderT?) Maybe[struct {
	X int "tag:`v"
}] {
	return h?.S
}

func variadicCase() {
	var av HolderV?
	check("variadic-absent", selectVariadic(av) == nil, selectVariadic(av) == nil, true)
	sum := func(ns ...int) int {
		total := 0
		for _, n := range ns {
			total += n
		}
		return total
	}
	pv := HolderV{F: &sum}
	var ppv HolderV? = pv
	gotv := selectVariadic(ppv)
	check("variadic-present", gotv != nil, gotv != nil, true)
	if gotv != nil {
		fn := *gotv
		got := fn(1, 2, 3)
		check("variadic-call", got == 6, got, 6)
	}
}

func chanCase(ctx context.Context) {
	var ac HolderC?
	check("chan-absent", selectChan(ac) == nil, selectChan(ac) == nil, true)
	inner := make(chan int, 1)
	inner <- 7
	var ro <-chan int = inner
	outer := make(chan (<-chan int), 1)
	outer <- ro
	pc := HolderC{C: &outer}
	var ppc HolderC? = pc
	gotc := selectChan(ppc)
	check("chan-present", gotc != nil, gotc != nil, true)
	if gotc != nil {
		var ro2 <-chan int
		select {
		case ro2 = <-(*gotc):
		case <-ctx.Done():
		}
		var v int
		select {
		case v = <-ro2:
		case <-ctx.Done():
		}
		check("chan-value", v == 7, v, 7)
	}
}

func taggedCase() {
	var at HolderT?
	check("tagged-absent", selectTagged(at) == nil, selectTagged(at) == nil, true)
	var s struct {
		X int "tag:`v"
	} = struct {
		X int "tag:`v"
	}{X: 3}
	pt := HolderT{S: &s}
	var ppt HolderT? = pt
	gott := selectTagged(ppt)
	check("tagged-present", gott != nil, gott != nil, true)
	if gott != nil {
		check("tagged-value", (*gott).X == 3, (*gott).X, 3)
	}
}

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	variadicCase()
	chanCase(ctx)
	taggedCase()
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
